title: UNCHANGING
tagline: The Giver of hope never changes.
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

session.prompt: Trace a good gift in your life back to its source — the unchanging Father.
Thank God for the gifts you'd stopped noticing — keep naming them as more come to mind.

coaching_notes: It's easy to forget the goodness of God. My prayer for you today is that you would remember some of those you've forgotten.
